dialogue.content: (おはようございます！本日はお願いいたします！)
dialogue.English: (Good morning! I look forward to working with you today!)

dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日は、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.content: (お願いします。こちらははじめられますが、いかがでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. I'm ready to begin when you are. How about you?)

dialogue.content: (はい、大丈夫です、よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Yes, I'm ready. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (始めますね)
dialogue.English: (Let's begin.)

dialogue.content: (はい)
dialogue.English: (Yes.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。どうしたらいいですか？コロナで仕事が減りました。
dialogue.English: Hello. I don't know what to do. My work has decreased because of COVID.

dialogue.content: お仕事のことですね。それは不安ですよね…
dialogue.English: It's about your work, I see. That must be worrying...

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいか一緒に考えられればと思います
dialogue.English: I'd like for us to think together about what might help.

dialogue.content: その上、妻に離婚を切り出されまして、、
dialogue.English: On top of that, my wife brought up divorce...

dialogue.content: それは…いろんなことが重なったんですね…
dialogue.English: That's... a lot of things have piled up at once, haven't they...

dialogue.content: そうなんです。もうどうしていいか、、
dialogue.English: Yes. I just don't know what to do anymore...

dialogue.content: そう思われるのも無理ないことです…
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable to feel that way...

dialogue.content: どんなお仕事をされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 仕事は飲食店です。
dialogue.English: I work at a restaurant.

dialogue.content: 飲食店でしたか…今お客さん減ってますものね…
dialogue.English: A restaurant... I imagine the number of customers has gone down, hasn't it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先が見えなくて気分が落ち込みますよね…
dialogue.English: It must be discouraging when you can't see what the future holds...

dialogue.content: お仕事はどのくらい減ったのですか？
dialogue.English: How much has your work decreased?

dialogue.content: 店を閉めていた間は、全くなくて、再開してからもお客さんがこないので半分くらいかと、
dialogue.English: While the restaurant was closed, there was no work at all. And since we reopened, we don't get many customers, so I'd say it's about half of what it was.

dialogue.content: それは…未来が見えない状況なのですね。。シフトが減らされた感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... so it feels like you can't see the future. Have your shifts been reduced?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですよ
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 急にこんな状況になり悲しいですよね…
dialogue.English: It's painful for things to change so suddenly like this.

dialogue.content: 奥さんはどんな風に言っているのですか？
dialogue.English: What has your wife been saying?

dialogue.content: はい、悲しく辛く、、妻には給料が減ったから、酷いことを言われ、、でも借金もあるから、、
dialogue.English: Yes, it's sad and painful... My wife said some cruel things because my salary decreased... and I also have debt...

dialogue.content: それは…地の底に落ちた気分になりますね…
dialogue.English: That must feel like you've hit rock bottom...

dialogue.content: ひどいことを…どんなことですか？
dialogue.English: Cruel things... what did she say?

dialogue.content: 離婚、、、と
dialogue.English: Divorce...

dialogue.content: ええ…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 仕方ないんです
dialogue.English: It can't be helped.

dialogue.content: こんな時だからこそ助け合いたいのに…って心苦しく思いますね。
dialogue.English: It must be heartbreaking to feel that this is a time you should be helping each other.

dialogue.content: そう思われてるんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: 仕方ないというのは…どんな事でそう思いますか？
dialogue.English: When you say 'it can't be helped,' what makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: お金がなく生活ができないから、子どもを連れて出ていくと言われ、離婚届まで突きつけられました。
dialogue.English: She said we can't make ends meet without money, so she's going to leave with the children. She even thrust divorce papers at me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…そんな…悲しい
dialogue.English: I see... That's so... heartbreaking.

dialogue.content: はい、どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes... what should I do?

dialogue.content: 大切なお話なので
dialogue.English: This is an important matter, so...

dialogue.content: もう少しお話しをお伺いして一緒に考えていけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: I'd like to hear a little more so we can think about it together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 確認なのですが、家族が一緒にいるにはどうしたらいいかを考えていくということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Just to confirm, is it okay if we focus on how your family can stay together?

dialogue.content: はい、家族とは離れたくないです。でも、そうなったら生きていけないし
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't want to be separated from my family. But if it comes to that, I don't think I can go on living.

dialogue.content: ええ、不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that would make anyone anxious.

dialogue.content: ちなみに…転職などは考えているのですか？
dialogue.English: By the way... have you considered changing jobs?

dialogue.content: はい、でも、自分が悪いから、、
dialogue.English: Yes, but... it's my fault...

dialogue.content: 転職より楽になる方法を、、
dialogue.English: I'm looking for an easier way out than changing jobs...

dialogue.content: お辛いですね…今は、どんな風にお考えなのですか？
dialogue.English: That sounds very painful... What are you thinking about right now?

dialogue.content: 時々、自分がいない方が家族が幸せなのかと
dialogue.English: Sometimes I wonder if my family would be happier without me.

dialogue.content: もしかして…ですが…命のこともお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: This might be a difficult question, but... are you thinking about ending your life?

dialogue.content: かぶりましたね、ごめんなさい。
dialogue.English: I seem to have spoken over you, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: いいえ、
dialogue.English: No, it's okay.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 続きをお話しくださいね
dialogue.English: Please continue.

dialogue.content: 前から時々、思ってましたが、、、
dialogue.English: I've thought about it from time to time before, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 離婚届で、、、
dialogue.English: The divorce papers...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: 楽になりたいと
dialogue.English: ...that I want to find relief.

dialogue.content: 楽になりたいというのは、離れたいということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say you want to find relief, do you mean you want to separate?

dialogue.content: 違います
dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

dialogue.content: どういった事か聞かせていただけますか？(お話しできるところからで大丈夫です)
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what you mean? (You only have to share what you're comfortable with.)

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 以前、心療内科でもらった薬が沢山家にあります。
dialogue.English: I have a lot of medication at home that I got from a mental health clinic before.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 心療内科に行かれていたんですね
dialogue.English: So you had been going to a mental health clinic.

dialogue.content: だから、まとめて飲んだら、目覚めなくていいか、、、なんて考えてしまいます。
dialogue.English: So I find myself thinking that if I took them all at once, maybe I wouldn't have to wake up...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…追い詰められた気持ちなのですね…
dialogue.English: I see... You feel completely backed into a corner...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのような気持ち、お話ししてくださってありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing those feelings with me.

dialogue.content: こっちこそ、こんなこと誰にも言えないから、、、
dialogue.English: No, thank you. I can't talk about this with anyone else...

dialogue.content: そうですよね…お話しするのも勇気がいることと思います
dialogue.English: I can imagine... It must have taken a lot of courage to talk about it.

dialogue.content: 転職よりも…と思われるのはどういったところからですか？
dialogue.English: What is it that makes you feel that way, rather than thinking about changing jobs?

dialogue.content: 離婚して1人になり、仕事もないのに借金があり、、生きていても仕方ないな、、と
dialogue.English: If I get divorced, I'll be alone, with no job, and in debt... I feel like there's no point in living.

dialogue.content: 絶望的に感じられているのですね…
dialogue.English: You're feeling hopeless...

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ちなみに…離婚の件はまだ奥様にお話の余地はありそうですか？
dialogue.English: By the way... regarding the divorce, do you think there's still room to talk with your wife?

dialogue.content: お給料があれば…とか。どんな風に言っていますか？
dialogue.English: For example, if your salary situation were different... What kind of things has she been saying?

dialogue.content: 離婚届け書くくらいだから、無理じゃないかな？
dialogue.English: She's gone as far as preparing the divorce papers, so I doubt it's possible.

dialogue.content: まだ相談者さんのお考えは伝えてない感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you haven't had a chance to share your own thoughts and feelings with her yet.

dialogue.content: 借金もパチンコだし、
dialogue.English: The debt is from pachinko, too.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 依存症だったのかも
dialogue.English: I might have had an addiction.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、今の状況にご自分にも絶望を感じていたのですね…
dialogue.English: I see, so you've been feeling hopeless about yourself in this situation as well...

dialogue.content: ダメな人間なんです
dialogue.English: I'm a worthless person.

dialogue.content: そう思われていたのですね…どんな風に変わっていきたいですか？
dialogue.English: So that's how you've been seeing yourself... How would you like to change?

dialogue.content: 変わる？
dialogue.English: Change?

dialogue.content: そんなことできるの？
dialogue.English: Is that even possible?

dialogue.content: ご自分に絶望感を感じていらっしゃるようなら、どんな風になりたいなどあるのかなと感じました。
dialogue.English: Since you seem to feel so hopeless about yourself, I wondered if you might have an idea of how you'd like to be.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: 家族と暮らしたい、、、今まで通り
dialogue.English: I want to live with my family... like before.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、そうお考えになるのはごもっともと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think it's very natural for you to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話をまとめてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんは、コロナの影響でお仕事が減り、奥さんに離婚を切り出されお辛い思いをされていらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: Due to the effects of COVID, your work has decreased, and your wife has brought up divorce, which has been very painful for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんは、パチンコで借金もあることも重なり、絶望感を抱え、薬で楽になりたい気持ちもあるとのことですね…
dialogue.English: On top of that, you also have debt from pachinko, which has led to a sense of hopelessness, and you've had thoughts of finding relief with medication...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自分が悪い…とも感じていながらも、でもご家族でいたいと願ってらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: And while you feel that it's your fault... you still wish to be with your family.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。だから、どうしたらいいか、わからなくて
dialogue.English: That's right. And that's why I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: とても絶望感に打ちひしがれ辛い思いをされていたと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine you've been crushed by a deep sense of despair and have been going through a very painful time.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、わかってくれて、ありがとう
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly it. Thank you for understanding.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、お話ししてくれてありがとうございます。ここからは、聴いてみてご提案したいことがありますが…いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing with me. Based on what you've told me, I have a suggestion I'd like to offer... would that be okay?

dialogue.content: はい、そんなことあるの？
dialogue.English: Yes... is there something like that?

dialogue.content: はい、ご提案させていただきますので、一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to offer a suggestion, and we can think it through together.

dialogue.content: へぇ〜
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: まず、ご相談者さんはご自分がつらい思いをされているのに、なおご家族の事を思いやっている優しい方だと感じました。
dialogue.English: First, I feel that even though you're going through such a difficult time yourself, you are a kind person who is still thinking about your family.

dialogue.content: 俺が優しい？
dialogue.English: Me, kind?

dialogue.content: ええ、わたしにはそう感じました。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's how I see it.

dialogue.content: そんなこと考えたことも、なかったよ
dialogue.English: I've never thought of myself that way.

dialogue.content: もし家族のことも考えず自分の事だけ考えているのであれば、勝手にしろと突き放しているかな、と。
dialogue.English: If you didn't care about your family and were only thinking of yourself, you might just push them away and say, 'Do whatever you want.'

dialogue.content: そうか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: ご自分が悪いと、ご自身を責められる罪悪感を持つのは、ご家族を思っての思いやりかと…
dialogue.English: That guilt you feel—blaming yourself and thinking you're at fault—I think it comes from your concern for your family.

dialogue.content: パチンコで借金作ったんだよ
dialogue.English: But I'm the one who got into debt from pachinko.

dialogue.content: ええ。それと同時に“自分は変わりたい、でもこんな自分が変われるのだろうか…”という葛藤と不安が感じられますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes. And at the same time, I sense a conflict and anxiety in you—a feeling of, 'I want to change, but can someone like me really change?' Does that resonate with you?

dialogue.content: そうだけど、金もないし、妻には迷惑ばっかだよ
dialogue.English: That's true, but I have no money, and I'm just a burden to my wife.

dialogue.content: わたしには家族に迷惑をかけて今更…とご自身を責めてらっしゃるように見えました。
dialogue.English: It seems to me that you're blaming yourself, thinking, "I've caused my family so much trouble, and now it's too late..."

dialogue.content: (お時間ですが、もう少し大丈夫でしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (We're almost out of time, but would it be okay if we continue for a little longer?)

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です🙆‍♀️
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. 🙆‍♀️

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます、続きお願いします！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you, let's continue!)

dialogue.content: 自分を責めるよね、俺が悪いんだから
dialogue.English: Of course I blame myself. It's my fault.

dialogue.content: そう思われてらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: そこでご提案なのですが、
dialogue.English: With that in mind, I have a suggestion.

dialogue.content: 何かあるの？
dialogue.English: Oh? Is there something?

dialogue.content: 今ここでおはなししてくださったことは、奥さんにお話しされていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you shared what you've told me here today with your wife?

dialogue.content: 話したことないね、
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 怖いからね
dialogue.English: Because I'm scared.

dialogue.content: 怒ってばっかりだから
dialogue.English: She's always angry.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ゆっくりお話しできそうな時はありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a time when you might be able to talk calmly?

dialogue.content: 外に行けばね
dialogue.English: Maybe if we go out.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 前提として、ご相談者さん、ギャンブルの事が気になっているようですが
dialogue.English: As a starting point, it seems the gambling is on your mind.

dialogue.content: そうだね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: やめたけどね
dialogue.English: I've quit, though.

dialogue.content: やめられたのですね
dialogue.English: So you were able to quit.

dialogue.content: ご自身で辞められたのはすごいことですね！
dialogue.English: It's amazing that you were able to quit on your own!

dialogue.content: 依存症の治療をやっている病院もあるので、そちらもお考えになってもいいのではと思いましたが、辞められたとのことなので
dialogue.English: There are also hospitals that treat addiction, so I thought that might be an option to consider, but since you've already managed to quit...

dialogue.content: 借金と病院通いで嫌になったんだ、、
dialogue.English: I got tired of the debt and the hospital visits...

dialogue.content: だから薬は余ってるよ
dialogue.English: That's why I have leftover medication.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…それも含めて外でご飯食べているときにでも奥さんにお話ししてみてはと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I see... With that in mind, I think it might be a good idea to talk to your wife about everything, including that, perhaps while you're out for a meal.

dialogue.content: ご家族への思いやり、自分に罪悪感があること、そしてこれからやっていきたい事、
dialogue.English: About your concern for your family, the guilt you feel, and what you want to do from now on...

dialogue.content: お薬の事…
dialogue.English: ...and about the medication.

dialogue.content: 聞いてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: Do you think she'll listen?

dialogue.content: 怒ってばかりとのことなので
dialogue.English: Since you said she's always angry,

dialogue.content: はじめに、「今日は、自分の本当の気持ち伝えようと思う。聞いてくれるかな？」
dialogue.English: it might be good to start by saying, 'Today, I want to try and share my true feelings. Would you be willing to listen?'

dialogue.content: へぇ〜
dialogue.English: Oh.

dialogue.content: と前置きして始めるのがいいと思います。心理学では、これを“レディネス”と言います
dialogue.English: I think it's good to start with a preface like that. In psychology, we call this 'readiness.'

dialogue.content: 相手が、お話を聞いてくれる心構えを作ることです
dialogue.English: It's about creating a mindset for the other person to be ready to listen.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: 難しい言葉だね、でも、やってみようかな？
dialogue.English: That's a difficult word... but maybe I'll give it a try?

dialogue.content: 是非、やってみてください！
dialogue.English: Yes, please do give it a try!

dialogue.content: その時に
dialogue.English: And when you do,

dialogue.content: 今のままじゃ、だめだもんね
dialogue.English: Because things can't stay the way they are.

dialogue.content: いつもは言えない感謝の気持ちや
dialogue.English: you could express the gratitude you usually can't,

dialogue.content: 感謝か、、苦手なんだよね
dialogue.English: Gratitude, huh... I'm not good at that.

dialogue.content: 言ってないな
dialogue.English: I don't think I've ever said it.

dialogue.content: そうですか。感謝は口に出すと、思った以上に優しさが伝わりますよ！自分に対しての絶望感、でも変わりたいから一緒に頑張ってほしいこと。
dialogue.English: I see. When you express gratitude out loud, it can convey more kindness than you might think. You could also talk about your feelings of despair about yourself, but also that you want to change and would like her to work on it together with you.

dialogue.content: 伝えることを手紙にして読むのもいいかもしれませんね！
dialogue.English: It might also be a good idea to write down what you want to say in a letter and read it to her.

dialogue.content: 手紙？30年位書いてないかも
dialogue.English: A letter? I haven't written one in maybe 30 years.

dialogue.content: 本当はご家族思いの相談者さんだから、きっとできますよ。いつもは恥ずかしくて言えない思いも、手紙だと意外とかけたりするかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: You truly care for your family, so I'm sure you can do it. Feelings that are usually too embarrassing to say out loud can sometimes be surprisingly easy to write in a letter.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 自信ないけど、手紙を書いてみようかな？
dialogue.English: I'm not confident, but maybe I'll try writing a letter?

dialogue.content: いい考えだね
dialogue.English: That's a good idea.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ええ、是非やってみて下さいね！
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yes, please do give it a try!

dialogue.content: こっちこそ、ありがとう。自信ないけど、やってみるよ、
dialogue.English: No, thank you. I'm not confident, but I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 今日は、相談して、よかった
dialogue.English: I'm glad I talked to you today.

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 絶望の中からも希望を見出そうとしているご相談者さんだから、きっとできますよ！心から応援しております！
dialogue.English: You're someone who is trying to find hope even in the midst of despair, so I'm sure you can do it! I'll be rooting for you with all my heart!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: ありがとう、優しい相談員で、俺は幸せだ
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm lucky to have had such a kind counselor.

dialogue.content: 頑張らないとな
dialogue.English: I have to give it my best.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。ええ、応援していますね！それでは、お時間ですので終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Yes, I'll be rooting for you! Well then, our time is up, so I will conclude our session now.

dialogue.content: (大変勉強になりました。ありがとうございました😊)
dialogue.English: (This was very insightful. Thank you very much. 😊)

dialogue.content: (ごめんなさい、すごい過ぎてしまい…。お付き合いいただきありがとうございます！)
dialogue.English: (I'm so sorry we went way over time... Thank you for staying with me!)

dialogue.content: (とんでも、ありません。最後までイメージがつかめまして、感謝です💕また、よろしくお願いいたします🤲)
dialogue.English: (Not at all. I was able to get a clear picture of how to proceed by the end, so I'm very grateful. 💕 I look forward to working with you again. 🤲)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ、またよろしくお願いいたします！それでは終了ボタン押しますね。)
dialogue.English: (Likewise, I look forward to it! I'll press the 'end session' button now.)

dialogue.content: (はい)
dialogue.English: (Okay.)
